checks.title: protocol_version is set
checks.detail: Version 0.3. Before 1.0, versions are compatible only with the same minor version, so personal agents built on 1.0 will skip this document. This checker validates against 1.0.

checks.title: organization.domain matches the serving host
checks.detail: organization.domain is travel.example, but www.travel.example served the document. Personal agents refuse a document copied to another host, and the www and apex hosts count as different hosts.

checks.title: At least one channel is listed
Every URL is HTTPS
checks.detail: Plain HTTP URLs at apis[0].url. Personal agents must not use them.

checks.title: API entries are complete
checks.detail: apis[0].url must be an HTTPS URL.

checks.title: Website settings are consistent
checks.detail: web.disabled is true, so browser_session_endpoint must not be listed.

checks.title: Protected resource metadata
checks.detail: resource is "https://www.travel.example/". It must be exactly "https://www.travel.example", with no trailing slash.

checks.title: Checker signs requests as a personal agent
checks.detail: Probes carry a Session JWT signed by https://www.travel.example/api/pap-checker/client, with aud https://www.travel.example, a fresh User ID and a fresh Session ID.

checks.title: Conversations require a Session header: www.travel.example
checks.detail: Served a conversation without a Session header (HTTP 200). Conversations belong to a personal agent and User, so the header is required.

checks.title: Accepts a valid Session header: www.travel.example
checks.detail: Returned HTTP 200 for an unknown conversation. Expected 404 conversation_not_found.

checks.title: Rejects a forged Session header: www.travel.example
checks.detail: Accepted a Session JWT whose signature does not match (HTTP 200). Anyone could act as any User's personal agent here.

checks.title: Checks Poppy-Version: www.travel.example
checks.detail: A request that declares version 0.0 returned HTTP 200. An endpoint that verifies the Session header must also reject an unsupported Poppy-Version.

checks.title: Browser-session page loads
checks.detail: Returned HTTP 404 without HTML and no form. The page gives the browser its one-time code.
